title: [NSW] $10 off First App Order @ Umall
body:
Deal: [NSW] $10 off First App Order @ Umall

[tenpercent] Free delivery from $69
They know us so well.
[bird380] I use their chinese version Umall, free delivery threshold is $45 but we have to pay $2 packing material fee + $0.5 fuel surcharge + 1.5% credit card surcharge .
[YLUO] It's these added costs that are driving me away!
[hippo2s] We used Umall and it was good for a while, then these surcharged started to get introduced and we stopped.
Other things to note
They don't use refrigerated van, so fresh food (veggies) tends to be less fresh. Milk drink products are to be avoided, arrive a couple of times room temperture, so we stopped buying them.
Delivery are private (their own) drivers so punctuality is hit and miss, miss most times…we had a guy said arriving all afternoon to only show at 7.30pm at night. We felt bad for the dude, so overworked…but…yeah we waited a long time that day.
They pick the veggies and fruits… it was noticeable that we got stuff that were not pristine, perfect specimens.
I would only buy dry, prepacked stuff from them…but the surcharges are also keeping me away.
[wearytraveller] That's insane. Was thinking about buying some frozen goods from them but glad I didn't.
[hippo2s] they pack them in these supposedly cold foil bags…but depending the delivery route. If you get it in the morning it should be ok, but we for some reason was always very late afternoon.
I got to peek inside their van once and all they had was one big styrofoam container where all the cold packages are kept, by midday all the cool air would have escaped with how many times they open and close it. I hope they improve. LV Fresh vans has actual cold storage.
[367] I found even with their surcharges overall prices are as good or better than our local market shop.
But I agree that perishable goods are hit or miss. After a couple of bad experiences I will only buy dry products from them.
[oatmatcha] Good to know. I was going to order frozen stuff from them.
Pretty sure what you've described breaches NSW food safety laws.
[367] If you're out of codes, TopCashback has a reliable 7% cashback
[everydollarcountau] Topcashback only supports English verison for 7% that is normally pricier than the app verison (In Chinese)
[carrawa] May be a Umall spiel about what they do in the description.
